ctaHeading: Own a Haines Hunter Boat Today
aboutText: Established 60 years ago in Derrimut, Haines Hunter has become a leader in Australian boat building. Our expertise spans the rugged Offshore R-Series, versatile Sport Fish boats, and luxurious Enclosed Cruisers. We meticulously design and construct each boat to withstand toughest conditions on Australian waters. With a nationwide dealer network, we make it easy to find your perfect boat.
servicesText: From offshore fishing to family cruising, Haines Hunter offers a boat for every purpose. Our series are designed with Australian conditions in mind, ensuring durability and performance. Visit our Derrimut facility or contact a dealer to explore the full range.

reviews.text: We purchased an Offshore R-Series boat from Haines Hunter and it's been fantastic for fishing trips off the coast. The quality of build is outstanding, and the Derrimut team was very helpful.
reviews.name: Steve Thompson

reviews.text: As a local business owner in Derrimut, I've recommended Haines Hunter's Sport Fish boats to many clients. Their durability and design make them top choice for fishing enthusiasts in the area.
reviews.name: Craig Wilson

reviews.text: The Prowler series boat we bought from Haines Hunter is perfect for family weekends. Excellent service from their dealer network, and the boat performs brilliantly on Australian waters.
reviews.name: James Brown
